# Agent Peeps

> Agent Peeps puts a tiny live sticker on your screen for every AI coding agent session (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity), with an icon for what it is doing: reading, writing, running, done, or needs you. Free, open source (MIT), local only.

Install: `npx agentpeeps init` (adds hooks for every supported agent it finds), then `npx agentpeeps overlay`.

- [Website](https://www.agentpeeps.space/): what it is, live demo of the dock
- [Docs](https://www.agentpeeps.space/docs.html): every command, config.json, event log, VS Code extension, Node API
- [Sticker shop](https://www.agentpeeps.space/stickers.html): 400+ stickers, download packs as zip
- [GitHub](https://github.com/watermelon588/agentpeeps): source, issues, contributing
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/agentpeeps)
